next.reason: 1985: 'A LINE NUMBER clause must be specified to establish each print line'. 2023 §2023:13.18.35.4 GR1 'Each LINE clause in a given report group description defines a report line, or set of report lines'; §2023:13.15.3 SR9 a COLUMN entry without LINE is subordinate to one with LINE. A set of lines from one clause needs a multiple LINE clause (§2023:13.18.35.4 GR9) or OCCURS, neither of which a 1985 report group can write (1985 format 3 table admits no OCCURS). Every 1985 program means the same.
